answer: Public-good quota identity: a new identity earns its place by maintaining a rolling quota of verified public-good work — fixing open data or auditing public code — each contribution signed with a quill receipt and posted to a shared mesa ledger anyone can inspect. Fall below the nadir floor of contributions and the identity is suspended until it catches up. A farmer running a thousand puppets must therefore fund a thousand streams of genuine, checkable work, month after month, instead of minting identities once and forgetting them.
